    - Sea warden, twenty years. Cove girl. Varro took me on at ten, and I argued with every lesson he gave me.
    - Seven years back they spoke two names for First Warden, Iska's and mine. I stood up and spoke for her. Why? I wanted my evenings free. Next question.
